title: Agent Skills Manifest
description: Configuration for agent skill fanout. Declares canonical all-skills entries, reference-only sets, and prebuilt packs to compile into one scope activation root.

skillName.description: A single safe path component: lowercase alphanumerics, dot, dash, underscore. No slashes, no leading/trailing separator.

packName.description: A single safe path component naming a directory under the registry's packs/ directory.

setName.description: A single safe path component naming a directory under the registry's sets/ directory.

versionComponent.description: A single safe path component naming a version directory (e.g. '6.10.2', '0.18.2', '6.10.1-next.31').

registryPath.description: A relative, /-separated path inside the registry. Rejects absolute paths, backslashes, and any '.', '..' or empty segment, so it can never escape the registry root.

sourceUri.description: Legacy bootstrap/import source. Direct external activation bypasses the canonical all-skills catalog and is deprecated by ADR-0001. Only file:// is honored at sync time; git URLs are refused because nothing in skillex clones.

scope.description: Advisory label only. Placement decides scope: a manifest at ~/.agents/skills.json is global, one at <repo>/.agents/skills.json is that project's. A mismatch is reported and ignored.

inherit_global.description: Whether a project's compiled map unions in the global map (project scope only; ignored on a global manifest). Project entries override inherited ones of the same name. This governs the project map's CONTENTS, never which roots are written - both scopes are always synced when a project is in play.

registry.description: Default Git repository registry URL for skills, sets and packs. Used only to name the local registry cache directory; nothing is ever cloned or fetched.

sets.description: Skill sets to synchronize, in precedence order. A set is a directory of symlinks in the registry under sets/<name>. Declaring a set projects every member it contains; you do not list its members individually. Sets are composable and are applied in array order, so a later set overwrites an earlier one for any shared name; an entry in skills[] beats them all.

anyOf.description: Shorthand for a registry set: '<name>'. Sets are not versioned, so there is no '@version' form.

name.description: The set name. Resolves to sets/<name> in the registry unless source or registry_path is given.

source.description: Direct source override (a file:// path). Mutually exclusive with registry_path.

registry_path.description: Explicit path to the set within the registry (e.g. 'sets/min-global'). Mutually exclusive with source.

include.description: If present, only these members of the set are projected.

exclude.description: Members to skip. Applied after include.

optional.description: When true, an unresolvable set produces a warning instead of an error.

packs.description: A prebuilt, non-composable skill root under packs/<name>[/<version>]. Declaring a pack REPLACES the activation root entirely: it trumps sets[] and skills[], and at most one may be declared. A pack selects canonical all-skills names; it never owns or materializes copied skill payloads.

anyOf.description: Shorthand for a registry pack: '<name>' or '<name>@<version>'.

name.description: The pack name. Resolves to packs/<name> in the registry unless source or registry_path is given.

version.description: Version directory under packs/<name>/. If omitted and the pack directory holds only version subdirectories, the highest version is selected.

source.description: Deprecated direct source override retained only for migration. Import the pack manifest and its member skills into the canonical registry instead.

registry.description: Git repository registry URL override for this specific pack.

registry_path.description: Explicit path to the pack within the registry (e.g. 'packs/bmad/6.10.2'). Mutually exclusive with source.

include.description: If present, only these skills from the pack are materialized.

exclude.description: Skills to skip. Applied after include.

optional.description: When true, an unresolvable pack produces a warning instead of an error.

flatten.description: Legacy copied-payload migration flag. Expands nested container/leaf layouts at projection time: an entry with no SKILL.md is a container and is descended into, while any directory holding a SKILL.md is a skill and is never descended into, so a skill's own references/ and scripts/ never become skills. Depth is whatever the tree is. The projected name is the leaf directory's basename, and entries whose name begins with '.' or '_' are never projected at any depth. Also enabled by [policy] flatten = true in the pack's pack.toml; include/exclude apply to the flattened names. New packs list canonical leaf names directly; flattening does not authorize pack-owned skill definitions.

sealed.description: Legacy copied-payload verification flag. Reproducibility now pins the canonical catalog and composition revisions instead of duplicating skill bytes.

skills.description: Individual canonical all-skills entries to synchronize. Resolved LAST, so an entry here always overrides a set member or a pack member of the same name. The projected folder name is always the declared name, never the target directory's basename.

anyOf.description: A canonical skill name, resolving to all-skills/<name>. A slash-bearing registry path is legacy and should be imported into all-skills before activation; declaring a pack this way is refused.

name.description: The local folder name to link the skill to. Resolves to all-skills/<name> unless source or registry_path is given.

source.description: Deprecated direct source. Import the skill into all-skills and reference its canonical name instead.

version.description: Legacy git branch, tag, or commit hash. Nothing in skillex clones or checks out, so this is refused at sync time.

registry.description: Legacy per-entry registry URL override. Refused at sync time; use the manifest-level 'registry' instead.

registry_path.description: Path to the skill within the registry. Mutually exclusive with source.
